_HOW_TO_EDIT: This is the ONE file that holds all the words, links, prices and videos on the website.
1. Change only the text between the quote marks on the right-hand side, e.g. "price": "$49".
2. Keep every quote mark, comma, colon and bracket exactly where it is. If the site stops building, a missing comma is the usual cause (paste this file into jsonlint.com to find it).
3. Anything in [ square brackets ] is a placeholder still waiting for real info from Mehrab.
4. Leave a value as "" (empty) to hide it or fall back to the placeholder, e.g. an empty youtubeId shows a placeholder box.
5. Videos: for YouTube, paste only the ID (the part after watch?v= ), e.g. "dQw4w9WgXcQ". For Vimeo, paste the number from the link.
6. Short muted preview clips (hero showreel + hover previews) go in the folder public/videos/ with the file names listed below.
7. To switch the accent colour to yellow, change accentColor to "#FFE11A".
8. Save the file. Netlify rebuilds the live site automatically after you upload/push the change.
